metadata.article_title: Revocation of continuing guarantee by surety’s death.

article.title: Revocation of continuing guarantee by surety’s death.
article.content: The death of the surety operates, in the absence of any contract to the contrary, as a revocation of a continuing guarantee, so far as regards future transactions.
article.html:
131Revocation of continuing guarantee by surety’s death.

Section 131 · Chapter VIII · page 35 of the Act

The death of the surety operates, in the absence of any contract to the contrary, as a revocation of a continuing guarantee, so far as regards future transactions.
